== Published English Original Virtual Set 8 wording ==
The November 2005 replacement names Bounty rather than an Effect with that word in its title. It retains non-prison deployment. The remaster drops that branch, specifies an opposing same-site forfeiture and makes removing the bounty Effect the cost of taking a retrieved card. Double Back and Alter immunity remain.
